verdict.rationale: Unity Gaming Services documents its own isolated environments: projects start with a production environment and can add up to 25 more for testing and staging, and changing data in one environment does not affect the others. That directly delivers testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; evidence that agent tooling (CLI/MCP) can target a non-production environment; the isolation is a logical partition only, with no provisioned resources.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Environments are isolated. This means that if you change data in one environment, data in other environments is not affected.
All projects start with a production environment. You can create up to 25 environments for a project.
